DOP: 1 pāsa m. ( and n. ?), 1. [ S. pāśa] ( i ) a loop; a noose; a snare; Abh 904 (khagādibandhane ~o); Vin I 21, 17* (antalikkhacaro ~o yvāyaṃ carati mānaso tena taṃ bādhayissāmi) = S I 111, 29* (Spk I 177, 17 : ~o ti rāgapāso); Vin III 62, 30 (aññataro bhikkhu ~e baddhaṃ sūkaraṃ kāruññena muñci); M II 65, 5* (odahi migavo ~aṃ) = Th 774 (Th-a III 36, 14 : ~an ti daṇḍavāguraṃ); Th 253 (asakkhiṃ maccurājassa ahaṃ ~ā pamuccituṃ); Ja II 153, 17* (iṅgha vaddhamayaṃ ~aṃ chinda dantehi kacchapa); 161, 17 (luddako … yaṭṭhiṃ ca ~aṃ ca oḍḍeti); III 184, 6 (eko migaluddako migavīthisu ~aṃ oḍḍesi); 185, 3* (daḷho vārattiko ~o pādaṃ me parikantati); IV 425, 28* (atha jālaṃ ca ~aṃ ca āsajjāpi na bujjhati); V 166, 18* (tad assu te bandhanā mocayiṃsu yaṃ natthuto paṭimokk’ assa ~e; 167, 33´ : yaṃ bandhanaṃ assa natthuto pavesetvā ~e paṭimokkaṃ tasmā bandhanā taṃ uragaṃ mocayiṃsu); 172, 28* (rajjuṃ gahetvāna daḷhaṃ ca ~aṃ); 337, 22 (nesādo ~ehi sakuṇe bandhitvā); 358, 29 (daḷhaṃ mahārajjuṃ vaṭṭetvā yaṭṭhiyā ~aṃ katvā … anto udake yaṭṭhipāsaṃ oḍḍi); Mil 152, 27 (akkanto pi ~o na saṃvarati); Sp 315, 11 (kumbhimukhavaṭṭiyā ~aṃ katvā); 383, 27 (~aṃ yaṭṭhiyā saha pāteti); Vv-a 207, 25 (rukkhassa sākhāya rajjuṃ bandhitvā ~aṃ katvā ubbandhitukāmā); Th-a III 28, 22 (mahindassa Sakkassa ~ena baddho yathā Vepacitti-asurindo); — ifc see kūṭa- ( sv kūṭa 2 ), namuci-; — ( ii ) a loop on clothing; Ps III 437, 14 (anukkamo vuccati ~e pavesanagaṇṭhi); — ifc see gaṇṭhi-; — 2. [ cf BHS -pāsa] the eye of a needle; Ja III 282, 3 foll. (ekaṃ sukhumaṃ ghanaṃ sūciṃ katvā ~e vijjhitvā … aparaṃ pi tathārūpam eva tassā kosakaṃ katvā ~e vijjhi); 282, 17´ (sundarena suviddhena ~ena samannāgatattā supāsiyaṃ); — ifc see sūci-; — 3. a die; dice; Ja 293, 12 (rājā jūtamaṇḍalaṃ sajjāpetvā … jūtagītaṃ gāyitvā ~e khipati, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se pāsake); VI 281, 29* ( in fn. : jambonadamayaṃ ~aṃ caturaṃsaṃ aṭṭhaṅguli); — 4. a mass; Abh 904 (~o kesapubbo caye); — ifc see kesa-; — pāsaṃ in Ee at Vism 665, 29 is wr for pipāsaṃ ( Be, Ce, Se so ); — pāsaṃ sataro in Ee at Sp 480, 21 : read pāsaṃsataro; — °’- antare in Ee Pv-a 63, 5 is wr for pāsāṇantare ( Be, Ce, Ee ); — °- pāṇika , mfn. , with a noose in one’s hand; Ja III 288, 15* ; — °- yaṭṭhi , °-laṭṭhi, f. , a pole with a snare attached, a pole trap; Ja II 37, 4 (~iyo ropetvā pāse oḍḍetvā); IV 338, 24 (~iyaṃ adhosiro olambamāno va, Be so; Ce °-laṭṭhiyaṃ; Se olambanto va; Ee °-laṭṭhiyaṃ … olambāno va); Sp 457, 12 ; Vin-vn 300; — °- hattha , mfn. , with a snare or noose in one’s hand; Ja III 287, 24 (tiṃsamattā dhuttā pi ~ā tatth’ eva aṭṭhaṃsu); IV 342, 14* ; V 371, 17* ; — apāsa , mfn. , free from snares, not caught; Th-a III 36, 27 ; — supāsa , mfn. , with a good eye (of a needle); Ja III 282, 22* (~aṃ ca … ko sūciṃ ketum icchati; 282, 24´ : ~an ti saṇhena pāsavedhakena viddhattā sundarapāsaṃ); — see also kuṭhāripāsa ( sv kuṭhāri ), pakkhapāsa ( sv pakkha 1 ), supāsiya.
